gui.guhs.botsguhs.bijna: Ten more seconds of power, njeg! Quick, one more bump!

gui.guhs.botsguhs.klaar_niks: Ride over! %s bumps. Make it %s for a fair ticket, vadsje!
gui.guhs.spookhuis.instappen: Hop in and hold on to your cheese snacks! The cart leaves in a moment.
gui.guhs.spookhuis.niet_nu: This cart is busy, wait at the station, njeg.
gui.guhs.spookhuis.blijf_zitten: Njeg! Stay in your seat, the little ghosts are counting on you!
gui.guhs.spookhuis.klaar: You survived! A fair ticket for all that bravery. VAHOEG!
gui.guhs.spookhuis.boe.0: BOO! ...sorry, did I scare you? Me too, a little.
gui.guhs.spookhuis.boe.1: Whoo-oo-oo! Got a cheese snack, by any chance? Ghosts get hungry too.
gui.guhs.spookhuis.boe.2: BOO! This is my scary face. I practised it for ages.
gui.guhs.spookhuis.boe.3: Psst! I'm not really scary, don't tell the others.
gui.guhs.spookhuis.boe.4: I am the Ghost of Forgotten Vads! Oooh! Will you wave back?
gui.guhs.spookhuis.boe.5: Leaving already? Come back for a shiver soon, I'll keep your seat warm. Well, cold.

ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kermis_botskampioen: Bump fifteen times in one ride. Two fair tickets, and the guhs' eternal admiration.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kermis_spookhuis.de: Do you dare enter the &dSpooky Guh House&r? Hop into a cart and meet the sweetest little ghosts.
